# Mochi

> A tiling window manager for Windows. The daemon mochi.exe arranges every window into tiles and binds its own keys; the client mochic.exe starts, stops and commands it.

Install: download Mochi-Setup.exe from /download/windows and open it, or in PowerShell, as a normal user, run `irm <this site>/install.ps1 | iex`. No admin rights. x64 only.
Both install to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mochi\bin, add that folder to the user PATH, start Mochi at login and start it right away. Mochi-Setup.exe --quiet installs without asking.
Config: %USERPROFILE%\mochi.json (JSON). Hotkeys: %USERPROFILE%\.config\mochi\hotkeys. Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\mochi, one mochi.log.<date> file per day.
Both files reload when saved. Run `mochic check` after every edit.
Pause (or alt + f12) turns tiling off and on. alt + shift + e, or `mochic stop`, stops Mochi and puts every window back.
Uninstall: Settings, Apps, Installed apps, Mochi; after a PowerShell install, run the installer with -Uninstall. Config, hotkeys and logs stay.

- [install.ps1](/install.ps1): the PowerShell installer for the latest release
- [Mochi-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip](/download/Mochi-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip): mochi.exe, mochic.exe and the config schema, latest release
- [Mochi-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256](/download/Mochi-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256): SHA256 of the zip
- [A file of a given release](/download/v0.1.20/Mochi-v0.1.20-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip): /download/<tag>/<file>; older releases carry the version in the zip name

## MCP server

`mochic mcp` runs a local MCP server on stdin and stdout (stdio transport).
An MCP client starts it: command is the full path to mochic.exe, args is ["mcp"].
The installer puts mochic.exe in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Mochi\bin. A client config in the common JSON form:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "mochi": { "command": "C:\\Users\\you\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Mochi\\bin\\mochic.exe", "args": ["mcp"] } } }
```

It talks to the running Mochi over the same local named pipe mochic uses. Nothing leaves the computer: no network, no account, no telemetry.
No tool can stop Mochi, close a window or write a file. check_config works without a running Mochi.
Tools: get_state, why_not_tiled, list_hotkeys, check_config, focus_window, move_window_to_workspace, switch_workspace, set_layout, toggle_float, toggle_monocle, retile, pause_tiling, resume_tiling, reload_config.
Call get_state first. Window ids are its hwnd numbers. Workspace and monitor indexes are zero-based.

- [SKILL.md, MCP server](/skill/mochi/SKILL.md#mcp-server): every tool with its arguments
